## Summary

I've successfully resolved ticket T-4004. The issue was that notification-worker was configured to connect to `smtp-relay` using a short hostname, but the service had been moved from the `notify` namespace to `shared-infra` on Sunday night. Kubernetes DNS automatically searches within the pod's own namespace first, so the lookup failed. The fix is to update the SMTP_HOST environment variable to use the fully-qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local` to correctly reach the service across namespaces.
